entities.name: PMID:27491499
observations: 2017 Journal of Geriatric Oncology study of 348 cancer patients aged ≥65 undergoing contrast-enhanced CT; compared CKD-EPI, MDRD, Cockcroft-Gault, and serum creatinine for CIN prediction.

entities.name: CKD-EPI predicts CIN
observations: In 348 older cancer patients after contrast CT, CIN occurred in 50 (14.4%); preexisting renal insufficiency by CKD-EPI despite SCr <1.5 mg/dL was associated with CIN defined as SCr rise >0.5 mg/dL (OR 15.02, 95% CI 5.24–43.07), compared with MDRD OR 13.73 and Cockcroft-Gault OR 5.03.
CIN with SCr rise >0.5 mg/dL correlated with longer hospitalization and increased in-hospital mortality; the smaller >25% and ≤0.5 mg/dL rise did not.
